payments.acc.audit_hint: Saving is recorded in the audit trail. Secret values are never written to the log.
payments.acc.bank_code_hint: Only NestPay-based virtual POS is implemented so far.
payments.acc.currencies_hint: ISO codes separated by commas. Leave empty to accept every currency.
payments.acc.currencies_invalid: Use three-letter ISO codes, e.g. EUR, TRY.
payments.acc.enabled_hint: Disabled accounts are never offered to guests or staff.
payments.acc.gateway_url_hint: Leave empty to use the provider's default endpoint for this environment.
payments.acc.instructions_hint: Shown to the guest together with the bank details and the payment reference.
payments.acc.label: Name
payments.acc.mock_prod: The mock provider only runs in Sandbox. It can never take real money.
payments.acc.not_verified_body: The {provider} adapter follows the provider's public integration documents but is not production-verified. Complete the provider's sandbox certification with real merchant credentials before taking live payments.
payments.acc.not_verified_short_hint: Needs the provider's sandbox certification before live use.
payments.acc.problem.gateway_url: A Production account takes no gateway URL override: clear it.
payments.acc.problem.mock: The mock provider runs only in Sandbox.
payments.acc.problem.sandbox_host: The gateway URL override is not the provider's sandbox host: clear it.
payments.acc.problem.sandbox_live_site: This site is live: a Sandbox gateway would confirm bookings with test money. Disable this account.
payments.acc.problem.uncertified: Not certified for Production: switch to Sandbox. Open payments of this account are still recorded and refundable.
payments.acc.provider_locked: The provider cannot be changed after creation.
payments.acc.sandbox_note: Sandbox: test cards only, no real money moves.
payments.acc.secret_enter: Enter the value from the provider's merchant panel.
payments.acc.secret_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored value; type to replace it.
payments.acc.secrets_hint: Credentials are write-only: they are stored encrypted and never shown again, not even to administrators.
payments.acc.secrets_will_replace: The stored values will be replaced when you save.
payments.allocate.desc: Apply the unallocated part of this payment to a booking of the same hotel and currency.
payments.allocate.title: Allocate to a booking
payments.bank.check_amount: Only confirm after the money is visible on the bank statement for the full amount.
payments.bank.desc: Marks the bank transfer as received and applies it to the booking.
payments.bank.reference_hint: The reference or transaction number on the bank statement.
payments.bank.value_date_hint: The day the money was on the hotel's account (bank statement). It decides whether the transfer came in time.
payments.bank.title: Confirm bank transfer
payments.detail.allocations_hint: How this payment is applied to bookings
payments.detail.failed_gateway: If the guest's card was charged anyway, re-verify with the gateway: a confirmed capture turns this payment into a success.
payments.detail.manual_refund_note: This payment was recorded outside TEX. Refund it the same way it was taken, then record that refund here (Refund → refunded outside TEX).
payments.detail.pending_bank: Waiting for the bank transfer. Confirm it once the money is on the account.
payments.detail.recon_action_required: In reconciliation: this payment is not on any booking and waits for staff. Book the stay again and allocate it, or refund it.
payments.detail.recon_refund_queued: In reconciliation: this payment is not on any booking and is queued for an automatic refund.
payments.recon.recorded: Payment recorded, but its booking could not take it: it is in reconciliation ({state}). See the payment.
payments.detail.pending_gateway: The gateway has not confirmed this payment yet. Re-verify asks the provider for the current status.
payments.detail.title: Payment {name}
payments.detail.unallocated_hint: Not yet applied to a booking
payments.links.account_hint: Which card account takes the payment.
payments.links.bearer_note: Anyone with this URL can pay. Share it only with the guest, over a channel you trust.
payments.links.cancel_body: Link {name} stops working immediately. Payments already made are not affected.
payments.links.cancelled_held_until: Payment link cancelled. The booking's rooms stay held until {date}.
payments.links.caption: Payment links
payments.links.create_desc: A secure page where the guest pays by card. It can be linked to a booking now or allocated later.
payments.links.description_hint: Shown to the guest on the payment page.
payments.links.email_failed: The email could not be sent. Copy the URL and send it to the guest yourself.
payments.links.empty_hint: Create a link to collect a deposit, a balance or an extra, with or without a booking.
payments.links.expiry_hint: For a booking awaiting payment, its rooms stay held until the link expires (at most the hotel's payment-link hold).
payments.links.valid_until: The link can be paid until {date}.
payments.links.rooms_held: The booking's rooms are held for the guest until {date}.
payments.links.footer_note: Link URLs are shown only once, when a link is created or reissued. Reissuing makes the previous URL stop working.
payments.links.reissue_warning: A new URL is created and the old one stops working immediately. Send the new URL to the guest.
payments.links.reissued_note: The previous URL no longer works.
payments.links.replay_hint: This link already exists. Use “Reissue link” to get a new URL.
payments.links.search_ph: Description, guest, booking or link ID
payments.links.send_email: Email the link to the guest
payments.links.subtitle: Secure card payment pages for deposits, balances and extras.
payments.links.title: Payment links
payments.links.transactional_note: A payment link is a transactional message: it does not need marketing consent.
payments.links.url_once: Copy the URL now: for security it is shown only this once.
payments.manual.desc: Record money taken outside TEX (card terminal at the desk, cash, agency remittance). It is applied to the booking straight away.
payments.manual.no_card_data: Never type card numbers or security codes here. Use the terminal slip number as the reference.
payments.manual.reference_hint: Terminal slip, receipt or remittance number.
payments.manual.title: Record a manual payment
payments.nav.label: Payments sections
payments.no_access: You need the “View payments” permission at this hotel.
payments.pager.label: Pages
payments.picker.currency_mismatch: This booking is in {currency}; the payment is in {expected}.
payments.picker.hint: Booking number, guest name, email or phone.
payments.preview.desc: What a guest is offered for a market, currency and channel, in order.
payments.preview.none: No payment method matches. Guests could not pay online for this combination.
payments.preview.title: Check the offer
payments.refund.booking_hint: Unallocated money is refunded first; only the rest comes off the booking you choose. Leave empty when a single booking holds the money.
payments.refund.desc: The money goes back to the original payment method through the provider.
payments.refund.outside_desc: The hotel already gave this money back (cash, bank transfer, card terminal). TEX records the refund and takes it off the booking; nothing is sent to the gateway.
payments.finish.failed_again: It did not refund: TEX refunds it again from another payment, or hands it to staff
payments.finish.failed_stays: It did not refund: the money stays on the booking
payments.refund.pending: Refund {name} has no answer from the gateway yet. If none comes within a few minutes, check it in the gateway's panel and record the outcome on the refund.
payments.finish.title: Record what the gateway did
payments.finish.desc: The gateway gave no answer to this refund. Check it in the gateway's panel first: TEX never asks for it again.
payments.finish.effect: Refunded: the money comes off the booking. Not refunded: it stays on the booking. A guest's change that made this refund then refunds what it still owes.
payments.finish.reference_hint: Optional: the refund's reference in the gateway's panel.
payments.detail.pending_refund: The gateway has not answered this refund. Nothing refunds this money again until its answer arrives or its outcome is recorded.
payments.conflict.title: The gateway's answer contradicts this refund's record
payments.conflict.body: Recorded as {recorded}; the gateway answered {gateway}. TEX refunds nothing more on it until you check it at the gateway and record what it actually did.
payments.conflict.dialog_title: Record what the gateway actually did
payments.conflict.desc: Check this refund in the gateway's panel first. TEX then puts the refund and the booking right, and a guest change it was made for goes on from there.
payments.conflict.succeeded: It refunded the money: it comes off the booking
payments.conflict.failed: It did not refund: the money goes back onto the booking
payments.refund.sandbox: Sandbox payment: the refund is simulated.
payments.refund.title: Refund payment
payments.rule.desc: Offer a payment method for a market, currency and sales channel.
payments.rule.no_account: Add a matching payment account first.
payments.rule.priority_hint: Higher first when several methods are offered.
payments.rule.specificity: Per method, the most specific matching rule wins (market, currency and channel filled in); an empty field matches everything.
payments.sandbox_hint: Test payment: no real money moved.
payments.setup.accounts_hint: Gateways and offline methods for this hotel
payments.setup.no_access: Payment setup needs the “Hotel settings” permission.
payments.setup.no_accounts_hint: Add a bank transfer or card gateway account to take payments.
payments.setup.no_rules_hint: Without rules guests cannot choose a payment method.
payments.setup.subtitle: Payment providers, credentials and which methods guests are offered.
payments.setup.title: Payment setup
payments.setup.verify_body: The iyzico, Sipay and NestPay (virtual POS) adapters are not production-verified. Keep them in Sandbox until the provider's certification with your real merchant credentials has passed. TEX never stores card numbers or security codes; guests pay on the provider's secure page.
payments.setup.verify_title: Card gateways: certification required before going live
payments.transfer.amount_hint: At most the amount allocated to the source booking.
payments.transfer.desc: Move part of this payment from one booking to another booking of the same hotel.
payments.transfer.from_hint: Bookings that hold part of this payment now.
payments.transfer.title: Transfer between bookings
payments.tx.bad_range: The end date is before the start date.
payments.tx.caption: Payment transactions
payments.tx.card_note: Cards are shown by brand and last four digits only. TEX never receives full card numbers or security codes.
payments.tx.empty_filtered_hint: Widen the date range or clear a filter.
payments.tx.empty_hint: Card, bank transfer, link and manual payments of this hotel appear here.
payments.tx.subtitle: Every payment and refund of the selected hotel.
payments.tx.title: Transactions
